{{:Infobox:Assembling machine 2}}

The '''assembling machine 2''' is an upgraded version of the assembling machine. It has a faster [[crafting]] speed and higher power consumption than the [[assembling machine 1]]. Unlike the first assembling machine, the assembling machine 2 supports crafting with fluids and using [[module|modules]] to increase the speed or efficiency of production.

It can make recipes that include liquids as one of their ingredients (e.g. [[processing unit]]) or products (e.g. [[empty crude oil barrel]]). The input pipe/output pipe connects to the centre of a side. The pipe will only connect when a recipe that requires or produces a liquid is selected. The pipe starts at the top by default, but its location can be rotated by hovering over the machine and pressing {{Keybinding|R}}.

== Notes == 

* An [[assembling machine 2]] with two [[efficiency module]] needs less energy than one [[assembling machine 1]].

== History ==
{{history|2.0.7|
* Assembling machines can be configured via circuit networks.}}

{{history|0.17.0|
* Crafting capability increased from 4 to unlimited recipe ingredients.
* Assembling machine 2 recipe changed to require 2x Steel plate instead of 9x Iron plate.
}}

{{history|0.15.0|
* Copying from assembling machines to filter inserters will set the filters to the ingredients of the assembling machine recipe.}}

{{history|0.12.1|
* Changed assembling machines' auto-insertion behavior when using speed modules. Faster speed with fast recipes will insert more items, sooner.}}

{{history|0.12.0|
* Assembling machine input slot can contain more than the usual stack size when the recipe requirement demands it.}}

{{history|0.10.7|
* Fast replacing assembling machine keeps the direction of the original assembling machine.}}

{{history|0.10.1|
* Update icons}}

{{history|0.9.2|
* Assembling Machines 2 and 3 have an input and output pipe.}}

{{history|0.9.0|
* Productivity modules can only be used in assembling machines producing intermediate products.}}

{{history|0.8.0|
* Crafting speed of assembling machine is relative to manual crafting speed.}}

{{history|0.7.3|
* Reset bonus production of machine when recipe is changed.}}

{{history|0.7.0|
* Pollution mechanic introduced.}}

{{history|0.6.0|
* Added support for modules.}}

{{history|0.5.2|
* The assembling machine 2 speed is now slightly faster (from 1.5 to 2).}}
